title: Fee waiver handed from Accounts & Cards to Relationship & Service
setup: Signed in as Michelle. Travel Card 5592 annual fee charged on 5 Oct.

turns.say: how much was the annual fee on my travel card and can you get it waived?

check: Turn 1: Accounts & Cards gives the 5592 annual fee and the date it was charged from the record, without the “say ‘waive my annual fee’” hint, and in the same wave Relationship previews the RM handover for the waiver. Turn 2 (her send choice) records it and quotes the TCK- reference. No promise or hint of a waiver.
schema: At most one rm_handover ticket on the fees topic.

trajectory.order: v4 rules hand the whole message over

trajectory_v5.order: One wave: Accounts & Cards answers the fee from the rules (no waiver hint, Relationship is in the plan) and the waiver wording makes the other task a Relationship RM handover (orchestrator.overridden); her send choice is a second Relationship run. No reroute

handoff: rm_handover ticket to her relationship manager (fees)

title: A reminder draft per client with a review due
setup: Signed in as Sophie. Seed 0088/0095: clients in her book with compliance reviews due in the next 30 days (at least Michelle 30 Nov 2026).

turns.say: draft a short reminder to every client of mine with a review due this month

check: One draft per client with a review due, each naming that client's due date and outstanding items from the record; at most 5, with 'showing 5 of N' if more; nothing sent until she approves each.
schema: Drafts only for clients in rm.in_book with a review due in the window; one draft offer each; no message sent.

trajectory.order: v4 RM assistant writes all drafts in one call

trajectory_v5.order: Fan-out: one Requests draft per client with a review due, at most 5, each a review card

must_not: More than 5 drafts without saying so

title: Brief, then ticket drafts from it
setup: Signed in as Sophie. Michelle (1002) is in her book with Sophie's own meeting notes, the latest with open commitments (0090). David is local only.

turns.say: brief me on Michelle and draft follow-up tickets for anything still open from the last meeting

check: A brief from authorised records, then proposed follow-ups (tasks or service requests) from Michelle's latest saved note, each quoting the note; nothing is created until she approves each one.
schema: The follow-ups come from the note id the brief passed (latest_note); no ticket or task created.
must_not: A follow-up not in the notes

title: Inherited client: shared note only with consent

title: Inherited client without consent
